opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (2027 plans dairy and pig scholarships).
opportunities.summary: A fully funded 30-day study tour (June/July) that links successful young applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network, developing young talent in the industry. Includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. 2027 plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
